Title: 499063-2026: France – Construction works for the renewal of bridges – RD 72 PR 34+915 RECONSTRUCTION OF A CIVIL ENGINEERING STRUCTURE, MUNICIPALITY OF MONTCHEVRIER
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Renewal of a road bridge in France – bridge projects are generally very relevant for sbp. Missing information on span/structural type and the fact that this is a project outside Germany reduce the priority.
titel: RD 72 PR 34+915 – New construction of a bridge structure in the municipality of Montchevrier
kurzbeschreibung: In the municipality of Montchevrier (Indre department, France), an existing bridge structure on the RD 72 at PR 34+915 is being renewed. The construction contract for the reconstruction of the civil engineering structure has been awarded to a construction company.
gewinner: SOCIETE D'EXPLOITATION DE TRAVAUX ET D'ENROBAGE DU CENTRE
gewinner_kontakt:
Contract value: 109944.22 EUR
Address: ZI La Martinerie, 36130 Diors, France
E-mail: setec@rogermartin.fr
Telephone: +33 254533700
projektbeteiligte:
Département de L'Indre – Public contracting authority (Place de la Victoire et des Alliés SMGP, 36020 Châteauroux Cedex, France, e-mail: drtpe-smgp@indre.fr, tel.: +33 254273436)
SOCIETE D'EXPLOITATION DE TRAVAUX ET D'ENROBAGE DU CENTRE – Construction company / contractor (ZI La Martinerie, 36130 Diors, France, e-mail: setec@rogermartin.fr, tel.: +33 254533700)
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Small road bridge with a very low contract value
- Pure construction works contract, structural design is not part of the notice
- France, but no complex or large-span structure apparent
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project is located outside Germany, no checking engineer tender
- Low construction volume, presumably a standard bridge without special need for checking
- No indications of a complex or exceptional structure
baukosten_erklaerung: read off (value of all awarded contracts corresponds to the construction contract for bridge renewal)
naechste_schritte: No further steps recommended; neither cooperation with the construction company nor checking engineer services are strategically relevant.
notes: CPV 45221119 indicates standard bridge renewal. Award criteria: 25% technical, 75% price. No indication of a design or engineering competition; structural design presumably already carried out separately or awarded internally.
